description: This file defines the EntityModerationRouteProvider class, which provides dynamic routing for the content moderation module in Drupal, specifically for the latest version tab of entities.

classes.name: EntityModerationRouteProvider
classes.description: Provides dynamic routes for content moderation, especially for the latest version of entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the route provider with the entity field manager.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the route provider using the container and entity type.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Generates route collection for a given entity type, including the latest version route.

methods.name: getLatestVersionRoute
methods.description: Builds the route for the latest version of an entity if link template and view builder are available.

methods.name: getEntityTypeIdKeyType
methods.description: Determines the type of the ID key for a given entity type, e.g., 'integer' or NULL.
